About HDFC Mid Cap Fund

An open ended equity scheme predominantly investing in mid cap stocks

Mid caps today could be the market leaders of tomorrow

What is HDFC Mid Cap Fund?

HDFC Mid Cap Fund is an open-ended equity mutual fund scheme that predominantly invests in mid-cap companies, which are companies ranked 101st to 250th by full market capitalisation.

Investment Objective is to provide long-term capital appreciation/income by investing predominantly in Mid-Cap companies. There is no assurance that the objective will be achieved.

Why invest in HDFC Mid Cap Fund?

Growth Runway: mid-sized companies can grow into tomorrow's large caps and may deliver superior long-term wealth creation for patient investors.

Proven Strategy: a long track record of finding quality mid-cap businesses.

Who can consider HDFC Mid Cap Fund?

This fund may suit investors who seek long-term capital appreciation (5+ years) and are comfortable with short-term volatility.

How to start investing in HDFC Mid Cap Fund?

Complete your KYC. Keep PAN, Aadhaar and bank details ready.

Visit the HDFC Mutual Fund website or app and click Invest Now.

FAQs

Can I invest in SIP and Lump Sum of HDFC Mid Cap Fund ?

Yes, SIP as well as Lump Sum investments are permitted with the minimum application amount being ₹100. Any additional purchase must have a minimum amount of ₹100.

Is this fund risky?

Mid-cap funds tend to be more volatile but may offer higher growth potential.

SIP or lump sum: which is better?

SIP helps average costs and reduce timing risk.

What benchmark does HDFC Mid Cap Fund track?

HDFC Mid Cap Fund is benchmarked against NIFTY Midcap 150 Index (TRI).

How did the fund do last year?

The fund delivered returns of 25% last year.
